title: Quiet Pickup
briefing: Find the phone, stop and hold TAKE. Carry it to the mint exit. One guard watches the pickup lane. Taking the phone raises the alarm. Use a decoy, then dash to the exit. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: Cone Lesson
briefing: Two robots cover the central rack and the lower lane. Its amber cone stops at cover. Wait for it to turn, then cross the open lane. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: Battery Dash
briefing: Bring the phone back down the east lane. Dash across the exposed stretch, or take the longer route behind the racks. Empty charge still lets you walk. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: Crossing Signals
briefing: Two patrols cover different crossings. The central crates make a waiting pocket. Cross one lane at a time; rushing both is harder. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: Sweep Window
briefing: The tower scanner sweeps across the roof. Wait behind a shelter, then move while its beam turns away. The beam cannot see through cover. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: Narrow Crossing
briefing: Two gates alternate across the middle of the roof. Mint means open; amber means wait. The gates wait for you to clear the doorway before closing. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: False Footsteps
briefing: Throw a decoy in the direction you face. Nearby robots investigate the sound, search there, then return. Use the opening or take the long route behind cover. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: Warden Gate
briefing: The Warden is slow, with a longer view. Lure it away from the exit. A dash also makes noise, so save it for the escape. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: Power Trade
briefing: Power A opens the west door. Power B opens the east door and turns on its scanner. Stop on a switch and press ACT to change circuits. There is a switch on each side. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: Two Targets
briefing: Recover two phones, one at a time. Deliver the first before collecting the second. The alarm starts on the first pickup and stays on between deliveries. Each phone has its own charge. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: Silent Circuit
briefing: Relay pads open their nearby door for nine seconds. Use the pads on both sides for the return trip. A clean run is optional: use a decoy if the investigating patrol blocks your crossing. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.

title: The Last Vault
briefing: Two deliveries finish the job. Switch circuits to choose a crossing, watch the scanner, then use the relay to open the inner vault. The Warden hears decoys and dashes. Alarm: guards move 40% faster as soon as you take a phone, rising to 80% faster after 30 seconds. Decoys beep for six seconds; mobile guards within nine tiles investigate.
